assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story / continuity edit. Asset type: original literary VN chapter-two outside-the-painting CG, wide 16:9 target 1920x1080. Reference image 1 is the EXACT existing outside.png restoration room and work desk to continue; references 2 xia-normal.png and 3 xia-smile.png define the SAME girl's face/hairstyle for artwork ON PAPER only. Create the next close narrative shot at this SAME wooden restoration desk at night, change camera to a modest elevated close 3/4 view so documents are legible as physical objects. Preserve room identity: honey-brown scarred workbench, black articulated metal desk lamp at LEFT with ordinary warm bulb, glass water jar, brushes and cotton swabs, night blue window/Chinese tiled roofs at back-left, original large easel at right with the same textured painting of EMPTY theater workshop/chairs/windows, no newly added person in that painting. Retain restrained hand-painted oil/gouache texture, slate blue night and warm amber lamp palette. Main new subject on upper-middle desk under lamp: TWO SEPARATE ordinary rectangular paper restoration-study documents naturally laid side-by-side with a little space, not joined into a single face. LEFT sheet is an aged color reproduction of an old painting/photograph, showing head-and-shoulders portrait of Xia He SMILING gently: same youthful East Asian woman, short dark-brown slightly wavy bob with small side braid, soft green-teal eyes, ivory collared shirt, muted blue pinafore and beige cardigan, as reference 3. RIGHT sheet is a graphite underdrawing study of EXACTLY THE SAME GIRL, matching facial structure, hair, clothing and head angle, but relaxed CLOSED neutral mouth and NO SMILE, as reference 2 neutral expression. Both are small tangible images drawn/printed ON PAPER with clearly visible ivory margins and slight paper curl/shadow; neither is a real person standing in the room, no human body outside the paper, no artist at table, no hands. The two drawings provide contradictory source evidence about her original expression. A single fine brush rests laid down beside the documents, no brush touching faces: conservator has paused face retouching to verify sources, no face editing apparatus or magic. Composition: two faces large enough to compare but completely in UPPER/MIDDLE y25%-62%, main paper edges end above y72%; bottom quarter quiet plain warm workbench for dialogue overlay; lamp and desk environment frame main documents, easel only secondary context in background. No readable words anywhere, only very faint nonlinguistic study marks if needed. No split-face, no merged heads, no uncanny doubles, no horror, no tears, no glowing faces, no magic, no floating symbols, no UI, no watermark or frame. This is careful physical art-conservation research, not changing a real person's face. Keep the original background painting's workshop empty and the physical room unoccupied.
